messages:
sara_support: Escalation from customer: trial credits not decrementing after batching + retries. They claim multiple successful embedding responses but ledger shows no debits. account acme-inc, customer id C-5192. Posting logs we received.

ryan_engineer: Can you paste request ids and whether they used streaming or batch?

sara_support: Request ids: rid_19ab..., rid_19ac... Batch embeddings via SDK v0.9.1 with retry-on-5xx. Timestamp ~2026-03-16T22:34:12Z. Server returned 200 and embeddings but billing shows no debit.

mike_billing: Looking at ledger — I see a late debit attempt for rid_19ab that failed with 'idempotency key mismatch' then no follow-up. Any chance retries used different idempotency keys? :thinking: 

ryan_engineer: If retry used different idempotency key gateway won't dedupe. But why skip billing? Is there a path where we skip token accounting for empty bodies? Need raw http headers (no auth) and request body.

sara_support: Truncated headers pasted below.

```
POST /v1/embeddings
x-idempotency-key: retry-167a
content-length: 0
content-type: application/json
```

Response 200 OK
```
{"request_id":"rid_19ab","embedding_count":10}
```

ryan_engineer: content-length: 0 is suspicious. Client bug may have sent empty body but server returned cached success. @deploy-bot any recent cache changes to embedding handler? :eyes: 

deploy-bot: deploy noted — embedding handler:service/embeddings v1.14 deployed 2026-03-16 21:40:03Z (no cache changes) :package: 

lina_sre: Pulling proxy logs for rid_19ab. Found edge returned 200 but internal worker responded 204 due to empty payload path. Proxy path short-circuited and didn't call billing hook for content-length==0. Searching for other occurrences.

mike_billing: Found ledger rule: 'skip_on_no_input' which skips billing for requests with content-length<=0 to avoid charging empty requests. If SDK retried with a different idempotency key we could end up with a cached success response but no billing entry. Matches what we're seeing.

ryan_engineer: Repro plan: simulate batch embedding with empty inputs + SDK retry toggled. I'll run locally and check gateway behavior.

sara_support: Customer insists inputs were valid (10 short strings). Possible proxy truncation on their side during retry. They are behind a corporate proxy that may strip body on repeated POSTs.

lina_sre: Need full request body capture. @sara_support ask customer to run `curl -v` sample request and attach SDK logs with --dump. If acceptable, we'll give a temporary API key and tail edge logs.

mike_billing: If proxy truncated body, workaround is to treat cached success with same request id as billable and emit a manual adjustment. I'll queue a provisional credit pending confirm.

sara_support: Sent instructions to customer asking for curl dump and SDK trace. Creating incident ticket and cc'ing AE for visibility.

ryan_engineer: If you can share repro I'll patch edge to not skip billing when success is served from cache without matching ledger entry — replay billing hook asynchronously. Low-risk fix.

lina_sre: Will add detection alert for content-length==0 responses in the proxy. Marking this P2 for now. If we see spike we escalate to P1.

sara_support: Customer replied: curl -v shows body present on their end but their SDK trace shows one attempt with content-length 0. x-forwarded-for shows corporate proxy in path. They asked for manual credit while we investigate.

mike_billing: Approved provisional credit of 150 trial tokens pending confirmation by SRE. Will post ledger adjustment once root cause is validated.

ryan_engineer: Opening PR to ensure server replays billing hook when cached success has no ledger entry. Also adding guidance to SDK docs about preserving idempotency key across retries.

sara_support: Thanks — I'll update customer with provisional credit + ask for the curl dump we requested. Will close loop when SRE confirms root cause.
